_comment: Local dry run of both phases (pnpm deploy:dry runs run(): the store, then the contracts). Chain 31337 is forge's in-memory chain, whose clock starts at timestamp 1, so startsAt 100000 is inside the inspection window (minLeadSeconds after that, under a year); nothing is sent. The stores are what onchain/pack_glyphs.py and onchain/pack_page.py write, and the texts below must equal the packed manifests' (the script refuses otherwise).
